title: Recoveries of type `SigMode.OnlyDKIM` can be reverted by anyone
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as the recovery will be reverted and the user still won't be able to gain access to his smart wallet  **Likelihood:** High, as anyone can execute this attack when `SigMode.OnlyDKIM` is used for recovery  ## Description  The way in which the recoveries in `DKIMRecoverySigValidator::validateSig` work are that when a recovery is executed, the `sigMeta.newAddressToSet` address will be granted `sigMeta.newPrivilegeValue` privileges. In `AmbireAccount` when an address has non-zero privileges he is allowed to execute anything in the smart wallet, making him an owner of
